name: Motorcycle Simulator Delaware
summary:
Ride Wilmington, Delaware, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

32 KM ROUND WILMINGTON
I-95 north out of downtown and high over the Brandywine to Claymont, then I-495 south beside the Delaware River past the Port of Wilmington, the twin towers of the Delaware Memorial Bridge on the horizon. Back over the Christina, past Fort Christina and the Riverfront.
